rules.condition: Parental income must not be more than Rs. 3,50,000 per annum from all sources at the time of selection.

notes: The scheme also requires students to be regular students entering class IX in Government, Government-aided or local body schools. The current profile does not collect school type or student class.

Students in Kendriya Vidyalayas, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas, certain residential schools and private schools are not eligible according to page 4. The current profile does not collect this information.
Students must have a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent grade in class VII, relaxable by 5% for SC/ST students. The current profile does not collect marks or academic grade information.
